# TEKKEN 3 (iron-legacy) — WIRING INVENTORY & AUDIT

**Lane:** Tekken 3 sub-lane, FULL WIRING + CANON CONVERSION (owner order 2026-10-20 ~08:06 CDT).
**Branch:** `tekken3-wiring-20261020`.
**Count method:** git tree of `main` via the GitHub git-trees API (recursive, blobs only,
`truncated: false`, 59,215 total entries repo-wide) — `teardown/tekken3/` held **19,435 blobs**
on main, matching the coordinator's count exactly — plus this lane's 40 added files and this
file + `CANON-CONVERSION.md` = **19,477 rows** below. Sizes are git blob sizes (bytes).
**Audit date:** 2026-10-20.

## How "WIRED" was determined

A file is WIRED only when the game/build actually consumes it or a direct derivative of it
(roster data, `moveset-library/`, stage registry, `game/assets`, canon the game reads) — a file
merely existing in the teardown is NOT wired. Every status below cites its consuming path in
the system table. Work in OPEN PRs would be marked WIRED-PENDING-MERGE; no open PR contains
Tekken 3 teardown wiring (checked `gh pr list` 2026-10-20: #357/#359/#355/#338/#337 are other
games' moveset lanes, #364 is a mocap retarget pipeline, #362 is open-source tools — none
touch `teardown/tekken3/`).

research tree, not this vendored copy).

## Prior-claim audit (coordinator brief)

| Claim | Verdict (tree evidence) |
|---|---|
| PR #243 — real T3 movesets for 45 fighters | MERGED 2026-10-18. In tree: `game/js/movesets.js` `MOVESET_IDS` now lists 73 fighters; its header states the movelists are built from the 7 teardown banks, with non-bank fighters honestly marked `"proxy": true`. The 45 figure was the count at merge time |
| PR #252 — "round-2 movesets" | MERGED 2026-10-18, but its actual title is "real Bass DOA moveset for Vain Abel + schema v2 editor contract" — it contains NO Tekken 3 round-2 movesets. Before this lane, only the original 7 T3 movesets existed on main. The 13 round-2 T3 movesets were extracted by this lane (2026-10-20) |
| PRs #242 / #261 — game modes | Both MERGED 2026-10-18. `game/js/modes.js` contains versus/arcade/story/training (#242) and survival/timeattack/team (#261) |
| PR #247 — 23-stage registry | MERGED 2026-10-18. The T3 portion verifies exactly: 15 T3 retro stages registered in `game/js/stages.js` with matching OBJ+atlas pairs in `game/assets/stages/t3/`. The registry total was not independently recounted (other lanes' stages are outside this lane's scope) |
| "10 T3 animation banks not extracted" (2026-10-20 morning claim) | WRONG as stated and now closed: 13 banks were unextracted (types 0,1,2,5,6,8,10,11,14,17,18,19,20); all 13 were extracted and SHA-256-verified this lane. Type 15 (Mokujin) is genuinely absent — BNS record 295 has size 0 in `bns-table.pkl` |
| `extract_fighter.py` (brief's named parser) | Does NOT exist in `teardown/tekken3/` on main (full-tree search). The teardown's real parsers are `tools/local/{moveset_extract,pose_assemble,usa_motion,usa_tables,kmd_parse,tim_extract,extract_stages,pose_sample_analytic,validate_usa_spline}.py` |
| RENAME-MAP.md: "iron-legacy (Tekken 3) — 100% complete" | Was premature when written (7 of 21 banks, 7 of 20+ movesets). Corrected by this lane's work + appendix in RENAME-MAP.md |
